reviews.text: Had to get the whole set. I really wanted to try the Snail Truecica line and it didn't disappoint. The cleanser really feels like it's cleaning your skin without stripping away the barrier, and the other products in this line are amazing in combination with this.
reviews.zh: 一定要買成套。我真係好想試吓 Snail Truecica 系列，佢冇令我失望。呢款潔面產品清潔得好好，又冇過度清走皮膚屏障，而且呢個系列嘅其他產品同呢款一齊用好好。

reviews.text: I love this one . I didn't had much expectations but i must say i Will stuck with it for a very long time from now on. My skin don't dry ,it feals really clean and it really helped with my acne.I am ready to purchase it again before go sold out. I am sure is gonna be amazing for summer too.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款。我本來冇乜期望，但我要講，由而家開始我會長期用落去。我嘅皮膚唔會乾燥，感覺真係好清潔，而且真係幫咗我嘅暗瘡。我準備好趁未賣晒再買。我相信夏天用都會好好。

reviews.text: Ever since my holy grail (Simple Micellar Gel Wash) came off the market, I have been on the HUNT for a new gel cleanser. I tried out the COSRX Good Morning Gel Cleanser, and it was pretty good, but not quite what I was looking for. This, this one is perfection. I find it a lot easier to emulsify and really get a good cleanse in. Love this stuff.
reviews.zh: 自從我嘅心頭好（Simple Micellar Gel Wash）停產之後，我一直四處尋找新嘅啫喱潔面產品。我試過 COSRX Good Morning Gel Cleanser，都幾好，但唔係我真正想要嘅。而呢款，就係完美。我覺得佢更易乳化，又可以真係清潔得好好。好鍾意呢樣嘢。

reviews.text:
Nice solid foamy soap, loads of foam with very little quantity. A little goes a long way. Fresh subtle botanical fragance that won't annoy sensitive noses. It doesn't strip your natural oils. I'm loving this one.
Definitely repurchasing when I ran out of this lovely cleanser ❤️
reviews.zh:
好好用嘅固體泡沫皂，用少少就起好多泡。只需要少少就夠用。清新淡雅嘅植物香味，唔會刺激敏感嘅鼻子。佢唔會令皮膚失去天然油脂。我好鍾意呢款。
用完呢款可愛嘅潔面產品之後，我一定會再買 ❤️

reviews.text: This is a really lightweight cleanser ! I've dealt with cystic acne for years, and I'm always looking for cleansers that take the day off but don't over dry my skin and irritate it. the texture of this is really nice, and it seems really balancing. Great face wash to start off your routine on a good note !
reviews.zh: 呢款係好輕盈嘅潔面產品！我多年嚟都有囊腫性痘痘，我一直都想搵可以洗走一日污垢，但又唔會令皮膚太乾或者刺激皮膚嘅潔面產品。呢款質地好好，感覺好平衡。係一款好好嘅潔面產品，可以為你嘅護膚流程開個好頭！

reviews.text:
First impression - the texture is a very lightweight clear gel. Quite runny and has a clean, but mild, citrus scent. A little goes a long way with a small amount of water also. It lathers up to a very soft and minimal foam which I personally prefer because overly foaming cleansers can be drying and tightening on my skin with that squeaky clean feel. This cleanser doesn’t perform like that. The skin is left feeling not only clean, but also incredibly comfortable. It doesn’t irritate acne or dry flakey skin any further. It just really reassures you that your skin is clean but not at harm. 

Because of the super gentle nature of this cleanser, I wouldn’t say it’s enough to wash off full make up completely on 1 cleanse but it’s enough to wash off sunscreen. But since it’s so gentle, you can use this same cleanser to double cleanse if you have make up on and your skin still won’t feel dried out. 

This cleanser is primarily used by my partner everyday who is going through a snail mucin phase and is absolutely loving it. He is noticing the small progress in improvements to his skin with less flakiness and dehydration. No more dull and matte skin. His skin has also been questioned by his work mates saying it looks more healthy and radiant!
reviews.zh:
第一印象係，質地係好輕嘅透明啫喱。幾稀，有清潔感但好溫和嘅柑橘香味。加少少水就已經可以起好多泡。起嚟嘅泡好軟、好少，我個人鍾意呢種，因為太多泡嘅潔面產品可能會令我皮膚乾燥同繃緊，而嗰種「洗到吱吱聲」嘅乾淨感我都唔鍾意。呢款唔係咁嘅效果。洗完之後，皮膚唔單止清潔，而且感覺非常舒服。佢唔會刺激暗瘡，亦唔會令起皮嘅乾燥皮膚更加乾。令人好安心，知道皮膚清潔咗，而且冇受傷害。

由於呢款潔面產品非常溫和，我唔會話一次洗就足夠洗走全臉嘅化妝，但係就夠洗走防曬。不過正因為佢咁溫和，如果你有化妝，你都可以用同一款潔面產品做雙重潔面，而皮膚都唔會覺得乾。

呢款潔面產品主要係我嘅伴侶每日用，佢而家正處於蝸牛黏液嘅階段，而且好鍾意。佢發現皮膚有少少改善，起皮同缺水情況都少咗。再唔會暗淡同啞光。佢嘅同事仲問佢，話佢皮膚睇落更健康、更有光澤！

reviews.text: Transformation of skin covered with acne scars! This! repair cream is exactly what I was looking for! Can the skin get this better just by changing one skincare product? Red scars that never disappeared no matter what I did, started to fade away and I can see new skin growing up.
reviews.zh: 佈滿痘疤嘅皮膚有咗蛻變！呢款修護面霜正正係我一直想搵嘅！只係轉用一款護膚品，皮膚都可以變得咁好？無論我點做，一直都唔消失嘅紅疤，開始慢慢淡咗，我見到新嘅皮膚長緊出嚟。

reviews.text:
My skin feels amazing after cleansing with this product. Other cleansers tend to feel over drying or make my skin feel tight. After using this product for a month now, I see and feel a big improvement in the condition of my skin. Clearer, healthier skin. I will definitely repurchase this product and the serum again.

My only "issue" is that I can't tell when all of it has been rinsed off my face unless I look in the mirror and see the suds wash away. Rinsing off and just feeling my face with my hands, it is very hard to tell if I've rinsed off properly. But that's also the beauty of this product because it really doesn't feel like it dries out my skin!
reviews.zh:
用呢款潔面產品洗完面，皮膚感覺好好。其他潔面產品通常會令皮膚太乾或者感覺繃緊。用咗呢款一個月，我見到同感覺到皮膚狀況有好大改善。皮膚更清透、更健康。我一定會再買呢款產品同埋精華。

我唯一嘅「問題」係，除非我照鏡睇到泡沫沖走，否則我唔知道臉上嘅潔面產品有冇全部沖乾淨。沖完之後淨係用手摸吓面，好難分辨有冇沖乾淨。不過呢個正正係呢款產品嘅好處，因為佢真係唔會令我皮膚乾燥！
